stem.text: Which statement describes an example of an extracellular enzyme?

A.text: Amylase in saliva is an enzyme that catalyses the breakdown of starch in the mouth.

B.text: Carbonic anhydrase is an enzyme that helps in the transport of carbon dioxide in blood.

C.text: DNA polymerase is an enzyme that helps build DNA molecules from nucleotides.

D.text: RNA polymerase is an enzyme involved in the process of gene transcription.
